title: M2TR: Multi-modal Multi-scale Transformers for Deepfake Detection
core_method: Multi-scale transformer with RGB and frequency-domain streams plus cross-modality fusion
key_metric: 97.93% accuracy on FF++ HQ; 99.8% AUC on Celeb-DF
key_strength: Captures local and frequency artifacts robustly
key_limitation: Does not target audio-visual synchronization or model compression
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite compresses an audio-visual cross-attention model and evaluates explanation preservation

title: AV-Lip-Sync+: Leveraging AV-HuBERT to Exploit Multimodal Inconsistency for Video Deepfake Detection
core_method: AV-HuBERT features, temporal modeling, and face encoder for audio-visual inconsistency
key_strength: Strong multimodal detection through SSL audio-visual features
key_limitation: Large pretrained components and high inference cost
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite targets compact deployment and reports parameter, size, latency, and EPS

title: CAD: A General Multimodal Framework for Video Deepfake Detection via Cross-Modal Alignment and Distillation
core_method: Cross-modal alignment and distillation for modality-specific and semantic inconsistency cues
dataset_used: Multimodal and unimodal deepfake benchmarks including FakeAVCeleb
key_strength: Explicitly models alignment and distillation in multimodal detection
key_limitation: Not designed as an edge compression pipeline with explanation-fidelity metric
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite combines compression stages with attention-fidelity evaluation

title: From Prediction to Explanation: Multimodal, Explainable, and Interactive Deepfake Detection Framework for Non-Expert Users
core_method: Classifier plus Grad-CAM, captioning, and LLM narrative explanation modules
key_limitation: Uses heavy visual-language and language-model components
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite preserves intrinsic cross-attention explanations in compact models

title: A Brief Review for Compression and Transfer Learning Techniques in DeepFake Detection
core_method: Pruning, KD, quantization, fine-tuning, and adapters for image deepfake detection
key_metric: Up to 90% compression with same-domain retention
key_strength: Closest edge-oriented compression study in deepfake detection
key_limitation: Image-only setting and limited explanation analysis
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite extends compression to audio-visual detection and introduces EPS

title: Do You Really Mean That? Content Driven Audio-Visual Deepfake Dataset and Multimodal Method for Temporal Forgery Localization
core_method: Content-driven audio-visual manipulations and temporal forgery localization benchmark
key_strength: Provides the benchmark used in PIN-Lite
key_limitation: Benchmark paper rather than compression method
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite uses LAV-DF to study compact audio-visual detection

title: Distilling the Knowledge in a Neural Network
core_method: Teacher-student distillation through softened output distributions
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite adds attention-map transfer and EPS

title: Attention Is All You Need
core_method: Scaled dot-product attention and multi-head attention
key_limitation: Does not address forensic interpretability or edge compression
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite uses cross-attention maps as explanation objects

title: Searching for MobileNetV3
core_method: Hardware-aware NAS and NetAdapt for mobile CNN backbones
key_limitation: General mobile vision model, not deepfake-specific
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite adapts MobileNetV3-Small to audio-visual student detection

title: Quantization and Training of Neural Networks for Efficient Integer-Arithmetic-Only Inference
core_method: Integer-only quantization for efficient neural inference
key_limitation: Does not address multimodal attention fidelity
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite evaluates quantization effects on detection and EPS

title: Transformers are RNNs: Fast Autoregressive Transformers with Linear Attention
core_method: Kernelized linear attention reducing quadratic sequence complexity
key_metric: Up to 4000x speedups in long autoregressive settings
key_limitation: May alter attention distributions in ways harmful to explanation fidelity
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite empirically shows Linear Attention collapses EPS in this task

title: Fast Transformer Decoding: One Write-Head is All You Need
core_method: Multi-query attention with shared keys and values
key_strength: Efficient attention variant with minimal change to query diversity
key_limitation: Originally designed for decoding, not forensic attention preservation
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite tests MQA in multimodal cross-attention and reports EPS

title: Learning Interpretation with Explainable Knowledge Distillation
core_method: XDistillation transfers predictions and explanation information through an autoencoder
key_metric: Improved explanation faithfulness vs conventional KD
key_strength: Shows KD can fail to transfer explanations
key_limitation: Requires auxiliary explanation approximation and is image-centric
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite directly transfers cross-attention maps and defines EPS

title: Good Teachers Explain: Explanation-Enhanced Knowledge Distillation
core_method: Explanation-enhanced KD aligns student and teacher explanation maps
key_limitation: Does not handle audio-visual deepfake compression
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite applies explanation-preserving KD to multimodal forensic detection

title: Interpretability-Aware Pruning for Efficient Medical Image Analysis
key_limitation: Medical image setting and pruning-focused metric
how_we_differ: PIN-Lite measures explanation preservation across distillation, pruning, quantization, and attention variants
